files.README.md:
# sample-benchmark

This candidate contains synthetic data for learning the computation contract. Its numbers, thresholds and dates do not describe real entities or current rules. It is not a registered built-in pack.

The declaration selects normalized records and their hash-bound structured views. `records.json` is illustrative input data; matching this JSON file alone does not make it normalized evidence. Use your registered normalization workflow to retain it as a structured source before computing.

Read `docs/declarative-computation.md` in the workspace for the language and operation boundaries.
files.research.overlay.yml:
domain_pack:
  name: sample-benchmark
  version: 1.0.0
  compatible_research_yml_contract: '0.1'
  human_gated: true
computation:
  version: '1.0'
  arithmetic:
    mode: exact
    precision: 64
    scale: 2
    rounding: ROUND_HALF_EVEN
  clock:
    as_of: '2026-09-21T12:00:00Z'
    timezone: UTC
    ambiguous: refuse
    nonexistent: refuse
    search_days: 366
  tables: {}
  aggregations:
    evaluation:
      description: Synthetic observations
      selector:
        source_glob: sources/normalized/*.md
        records_pointer: /records
        row_key: /id
        allow_empty: false
      filter: record.status == 'completed'
      group_by:
      - record.model
      metrics:
        count:
          op: count
          expr: null
          denominator: null
          unit: records
        avg_score:
          op: avg
          expr: record.score
          denominator: null
          unit: ratio
        maximum_latency:
          op: max
          expr: record.latency_ms
          denominator: null
          unit: ms
      output_target: null
  graphs:
    report:
      description: Synthetic worksheet
      inputs:
        score:
          kind: aggregation
          id: evaluation
          metric: avg_score
          group:
          - sample-model
          reduce: null
        latency:
          kind: aggregation
          id: evaluation
          metric: maximum_latency
          group:
          - sample-model
          reduce: null
      constants:
        penalty:
          value: '0.05'
          unit: 1/ms
      nodes:
        normalized_score:
          expr: score * 100
          unit: percent
        efficiency:
          expr: normalized_score / (1 + latency * constants.penalty)
          unit: score
      output_mapping:
        score_pct: normalized_score
        efficiency: efficiency
      output_page: null
  invariants:
    score_bounds:
      description: Declared synthetic constraint
      target: computed
      selector: null
      inputs:
        score:
          kind: aggregation
          id: evaluation
          metric: avg_score
          group:
          - sample-model
          reduce: null
      filter: null
      assertion: score >= 0 and score <= 1
      severity: error
      failure_message: Declared constraint requires review.
  cadence:
    next_check:
      description: Synthetic review date
      trigger:
        type: fixed_date
        at: '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'
      lead_alerts:
      - amount: 2
        unit: days
      action:
        kind: evaluate_graph
        target: report
